home.flow: State 1: Input Mode (Left: JD Textarea, Right: CV Textarea). State 2: Preview Mode (Left: Keyword Analysis & Match Score + Download/Back CTAs, Right: A4 Resume Preview).
home.instructions: Use React state to toggle between Input and Preview. Keep the split-screen layout constant. The transition should feel instant and professional.

rules: Use `break-inside-avoid` (CSS: `page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid;`) on ALL major sections (Experience item, Education item, etc) to prevent breaking across pages.
Header: Name (text-3xl font-bold), Title, Contact Info (email, phone, location) separated by bullets.
Core Competencies: Flex wrap of comma-separated keywords or small bordered pills.
Professional Experience: Job Title, Company, Dates, Location, and Bullet points.
Education, Certifications, Language: Clean listed formats.
Typography in Resume: Use standard highly legible font styles. Name: 24pt, Section Headers: 12pt bold uppercase with bottom border, Body: 10pt/11pt.
Spacing in Resume: Tighten vertical gaps to fit within A4 limits realistically. Use margin-bottom (mb-4) for sections.
Ensure contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 for all text.
Ensure input fields have descriptive placeholder text and aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts for Cabinet Grotesk (or use equivalent like Inter/Outfit if unavailable via Fontsource) and IBM Plex Sans.
Implement pure JS keyword matching: Extract words from JD, remove common stop words (and, the, to, etc.), check against CV text. Score = (Matches / Total JD Keywords) * 100.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the split-screen layout to maintain exact control over borders and full-height scrolling.
For PDF generation, use `react-to-print` (best for preserving React component CSS) or `html2pdf.js`. Ensure the resume wrapper enforces the A4 dimensions strictly.
Do NOT use any AI or external API for keyword matching. It must be synchronous local JS logic.
Ensure all components are written in `.jsx` or `.js` as per the system environment constraints.
